fields.name: Original form
fields.value: Activity identification in workflow mining and multi-perspective simplification in Fuzzy Mining. The reconstructed initial problem is: Very fine records create uninterpretable detail; coarse labels erase distinct states, exceptions and causal alternatives.

fields.name: Problem it addressed
fields.value: Very fine records create uninterpretable detail; coarse labels erase distinct states, exceptions and causal alternatives.

fields.name: Failure mode it tries to prevent
fields.value: Very fine records create uninterpretable detail; coarse labels erase distinct states, exceptions and causal alternatives.

fields.name: Mechanism
fields.value: Choose an activity vocabulary at the level of the decision, retain the mapping from raw observations to abstract events, and test whether material conclusions survive a plausible finer or coarser alternative. Treat an abstract event as a derived object, not a newly observed fact.

fields.name: Trigger or context
fields.value: Raw logs are too fine, labels combine distinct tasks, or analysis must cross systems with different granularity.

fields.name: Non trigger or cheap path
